integrity: Proof uses the prime number theorem in fixed arithmetic progressions and Brun--Titchmarsh. Standalone exact residue and CRT checks plus finite prime counts were performed; finite checks are not the infinite-density proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed odd shifts only; no uniformity for shifts growing with the prime cutoff; publication priority relative to possibly unindexed general shifted-squarefree sieve results remains uncertain.
title: Exact shifted-flat prime densities and a sharp ternary gap
